test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 7 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The committee will ________________ a survey on the government schemes.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Conduct.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In this context, the committee is responsible for conducting a survey on the government schemes, which implies that they will be collecting data and information about the schemes. 
 
• To **conduct **a survey means** to carry out or organize a survey.**
 
• In this context, the committee is responsible for conducting a survey on the government schemes.
 
 
• Example: The marketing team **conducted **a survey to understand the customer's preferences.
 
 
 
• **Option 2 - fight **- is not appropriate in this context as it does not make sense to fight a survey.
 
• **Option 3 - hold **- is a possible answer, but it is not as appropriate as conduct. Hold means to organize or arrange an event or meeting.
 
 
• Example: The school will **hold **a parent-teacher meeting next week.
 
 
 
• **Option 4 - originate **- is not appropriate in this context as it means to begin or start something.
 
 
• Example: The idea for the new product **originated **from the research team.
 
 
 
• Therefore,** option 1, conduct,** is the most appropriate choice.
